more_info.uses: EU permissions include unflavoured live fermented cream products and substitute products, both with a fat  content of less than 20 %. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Starch is first oxidised with sodium hypochlorite and then esterified with acetic anhydride. The product is a chemically modified carbohydrate.
more_info.overview: Acetylated oxidised starch is classified in food technology as a thickening agent. Its technological role is to increase thickness.
